text: A root at every swept place, and no rational root.
evidence: The three factor columns show which factor has the root at each place. A rational root of
this monic integer polynomial is a rational square root of 13, 17 or 221; `root n with 2`
gives DOMAIN for a rational with no rational root (tools/adf/README.md:573).
argument: At a prime p that does not divide 2 * 13 * 17, if neither 13 nor 17 is a square mod p then
221 = 13 * 17 is, because the Legendre symbol is multiplicative
(refs/src/shoup-ntb/ntb-v2.txt:15014, Theorem 12.1 (ii)), and a unit that is a square mod
an odd p is a square in Q_p (refs/src/conrad-hensel/hensel.txt:160-170). So only R, 2, 13
